1. II.7

Let $T_a<\infty $ be large enough that $B_{T_a}$ (defined as in Proposition 9.3) contains $Y$.

\begin{equation} Z = \partial V_{j},\quad \hat Z_t = f(t)(Z)\\ \quad \hat Y_t = f(t)(Y),\quad \hat W_t = \M _t^+ - \Int (\hat Y_t) \end{equation}

Proposition
[incompressibility of cuspidal tori proposition]
